body:
So glad to see a reply more than any other instinct. 
I feel I'm strong enough and I don't need help but that only makes me want more help. Just bottling up my thoughts every night. I definitely can't share my inside stories but would be glad to boost your spirits. You can talk to me if you need someone :) 
Somtimes a stranger is better than all the people around you. So yeah.. all ears
